2608.18940.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
2608.18940.paper_summary: Single-step retrosynthesis is a central component of computer-aided synthesis planning, yet its intrinsically one-to-many nature is poorly captured by single-answer evaluation and benchmarking protocols. To address this, we introduce Top-K prompting as a robust training and inference paradigm to better capture diverse, plausible reaction predictions. We compile CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL, an ultra-large-scale dataset of ~45.6 million verified reactions to train the C3LM (Chemistry Constraint-Consistent Language Model). By integrating fine-tuning with ChemCensor-based and novelty-oriented rewards, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OOD URSA-expert-2026 benchmark. Further analysis of reaction uniqueness shows that LLMs and conventional models explore complementary reaction spaces, motivating ensemble-based retrosynthesis systems. Overall, our results establish Top-K, plausibility-aware training as a practical new direction for robust future LLM-based synthesis planning.
2608.18940.paper_summary_zh: 單步逆合成是計算機輔助合成規劃的核心組成部分，但其內在的一對多特性在單一答案評估和基準測試協議中表現不佳。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 Top-K 提示作為一種穩健的訓練和推理範式，以更好地捕捉多樣且合理的反應預測。我們編輯了 CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL，這是一個超大規模的數據集，包含約 4560 萬個經過驗證的反應，用於訓練 C3LM（化學約束一致語言模型）。通過將微調與基於 ChemCensor 的獎勵和新穎性導向獎勵相結合，我們的模型在 OOD URSA-expert-2026 基準測試中達到了最先進的性能。進一步的反應獨特性分析顯示，LLMs 和傳統模型探索互補的反應空間，促進了基於集成的逆合成系統。總的來說，我們的結果確立了 Top-K、考慮合理性的訓練作為未來基於 LLM 的合成規劃的一個實用新方向。
